OLI (9) | longest losses = HNP (9) | prevseason = [[2018–19 Liga Nacional de Honduras|2018–19]] | nextseason = [[2020–21 Honduran Liga Nacional|2020–21]] | updated = 15 March 2020 }} The '''2019–20 Honduran Liga Nacional''' season was the 54th [[Liga Nacional de Fútbol Profesional de Honduras|Honduran Liga Nacional]] edition since its establishment in 1965. The tournament started in July 2019 and ended in March 2020. The season was divided into two halves (Apertura and Clausura), each crowning one champion. A new format will be used starting this season, each club plays the others twice (a double [[Round-robin tournament|round-robin system]]), once at their home stadium and once at that of their opponents', for 18 games. The first five teams will advance to the post-season (Pentagonal), where they will play each other once. If the same team wins both phases, they will be crowned champions automatically; otherwise, a final series will be scheduled between the winners of both phases. This format was last used in [[1992–93 Honduran Liga Nacional|1992–93]].{{cite web |title=No más repechajes, vuelven las pentagonales a la Liga SalvaVida |url=https://www.diariomas.hn/2019/06/18/no-mas-repechajes-vuelven-las-pentagonales-a-la-liga-salvavida/ |website=DiarioMas.hn |date=18 June 2019 |publisher=[[La Tribuna (Honduras)|Diario Mas]] |access-date=18 June 2019}} At the end of the season, the three teams with the best record will qualify to the [[2020 CONCACAF League]]. Following the 13th matchday on 15 March 2020 the Clausura tournament was suspended due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Honduras]].{{cite web | title=SUSPENDIDO! torneo Clausura de la Liga Nacional |date=16 March 2020|url=https://www.latribuna.hn/2020/03/16/suspendido-torneo-clausura-de-la-liga-nacional/}} On 29 April the tournament was officially cancelled with no champion declared and no team relegated.{{Cite web|url=https://www.latribuna.hn/2020/04/29/sin-campeon-y-sin-descendido-el-torneo-clausura/amp/|title=Sin campeón y sin descendido el torneo Clausura de la Liga Nacional – Diario la Tribuna|access-date=2020-04-30|archive-date=2020-11-03|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201103145937/https://www.latribuna.hn/2020/04/29/sin-campeon-y-sin-descendido-el-torneo-clausura/amp/|url-status=dead}} ==2019–20 teams== {{Location map+| Honduras | width=400 | float = | caption = Location of teams in 2019–20 season |places= {{Location map~| Honduras | lat = 15.24 | long = -87.48 | label = [[C.D.
